properties.name: Scambodia — Public prototype
properties.description: Public v0.2.4 local offline Z01 dormitory graybox. Native multiplayer connection bug remains open; campaign and recovery unverified. Offline StatsSandbox adds local fractional resources, injury/downed timing and cancellable CH04 rescue; multiplayer/capture/checkpoint integration remains pending. v0.3.1: native lobby/arena diagnostics and safe Esc; peer join failure remains unverified.
